lead: A closure object's slot layout has a third party, and it is a test in `nvs-stdlib`.
body: `closure_of` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/allocation_policy.rs` hand-builds a closure with the reserved slots and a Rust `invoke`, so adding a reserved slot in `nvs-ir` breaks it as `field slot N is out of range for a class with N slots` from `nvs_runtime::object`, three crates from the edit. `grep -rn CLOSURE_ARITY_SLOT --include=*.rs crates/` finds every builder in one call; do that before moving the layout, not after.
